profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
Accomplished professional with 9+ years exceptional experience in providing excellent customer service, handling a diverse range of customer transactions, and working in fast paced environments. Strong business leader dedicated to continuous improvement through process optimization and a focus on efficiency.


Expertise:
Communication 
Customer Service 
Training & Development 
 Decision Making 
Adaptability
Self-Starter

Skills:
Data Analytics
Leadership
Microsoft Office 
Handle Pressure
 Computer Skills


Additional Experience:
ASSISTANT MANAGER
Against All Odds
2007 – 2009
ASSISTANT MANAGER
Finish Line
2005 – 2007

positions.title: Loss Recovery Lease Account Rep II/ Funding Operations Funder
positions.description:
•	Spearheading customer satisfaction and account resolution via active listening, negotiation tactics and empathetic reasoning. 
•	De-escalating irate situations, pioneering more in-depth projects and demonstrates ability to go above and beyond to make the overall customer experience as efficient as possible.
•	Serving as a member of the company’s Diversity & Inclusion program, and formerly involved in testing the new V8 system, Escalations, The Process Committee, Employee Committee, Spirit Sub-Committee and GM Financials Formal Mentoring Program.
•	Revamped and restructured department training binders and led a team of 10+ to strategize process optimization.
•	Took initiative to assist management with account corrections, which dropped complaint calls and increased customer payment calls.

positions.title: Teller
positions.description:
•	Expeditiously processed standard teller transactions for customers including servicing client accounts, cashing checks, balancing cash drawers and correcting discrepancies.
•	Processed 20+ customer transactions per hour with extreme attention to detail
•	Swiftly established credibility with clients and remembered 50+ names of regulars, creating a friendly rapport with customers.
•	Recognized for consistently balancing cash drawer and consistently received numerous customer service compliments.
•	Investigated documents thoroughly and eliminated loss due to fraud.

positions.title: Home Based Reservations Rep. (Domestic Sales, AA.com Tech Support)
positions.description:
•	Strengthened self-disciplinary and accountability skills while performing job functions with minimal supervision as a Home Based Reservations Representative.
•	Effectively interacted and corresponded with customers on phone and responded to their queries and requests in a positive and constructive manner.
•	Received recognition for getting 100% on all training exams.
•	Received BRAAVO bucks for compliments and meeting monthly goals.
•	Remained in self-managed employee for duration of employment.

positions.title: Assistant Manager in Training
positions.description:
•	Trained 20+ new associates, developing them into productive team members with excellent product knowledge.
•	Ended the 2012 fiscal year earning the company over $270,000 through implementing visual merchandising directives which attracted new business.
•	Received a 90% on a company mystery shop.
•	Streamlined interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively under pressure by greeting customers, deciphering and resolving their needs.
